name: Elizabeth Osei
life: “I still remember an old nurse adjusting her own swollen cuff.” People around the market by Market Flats know Elizabeth by a small Sunday habit. Elizabeth often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I can identify the old maternity uniforms by their flat-backed buttons. I wore one through both winters.
appearance: Elizabeth has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Look for tightly curled gray hair. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is an unlined tan jacket with a little coil of soft measuring tape. In conversation Elizabeth looks down for a moment before saying something difficult.
personality: Elizabeth has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To recognize the old maternity workers beyond their uniforms.
family: Sam Fox is Elizabeth’s younger cousin. Elizabeth asks before bringing somebody along. Sam can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *Two names on the chart*, Sam says, “I copied her old hospital number onto a holiday card once.”
connections: Benjamin Lewis. A child's costume moon survives beside an older worker's maternity buttons.

reactions.situation: A child takes the most valuable button
reactions.response: Elizabeth lets the child show what the button is for before calling it too valuable.
reactions.asWritten: A child takes the most valuable button. Elizabeth lets the child show what the button is for before calling it too valuable.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Elizabeth takes one immediate task off their hands and asks when they want to tell the supervisor.

reactions.situation: When a private quarrel becomes a public joke
reactions.response: Elizabeth says the plainest truthful thing possible and changes the subject.
